outcome: association between early pregnancy HbA1c levels and pre-eclampsia
cohort: 100 pregnant women attending an outpatient clinic in a tertiary care center before 12 weeks of gestation
finding: The study found an association between early pregnancy HbA1c levels and pre-eclampsia, suggesting that early detection of elevated HbA1c levels may help identify women at risk for pre-eclampsia.
birth_weight: measured but not reported in abstract
